cause: Event-triggered pumpWrite bypassed the end-only policy. An active terminal write is rejected by the terminal adapter and clears the coordinator editor; a finishing event can prematurely consume its single commit.
repair: One central gate blocks terminal/end-only live or event writes. tryFinish alone authorizes finalDelivery after required recognition/drain/acknowledgement/polish state is ready.
verification: Public start/event/stop through the production coordinator, bridge and native BaseInputConnection consume-and-clear terminal fixture.
Accessibility events during active speech preserve terminal binding and dispatch no text.
Finishing events before the last transcript dispatch no partial text; the complete result commits once after recognition is ready.
Existing terminal input and Unicode preserved; newline/control actions removed; no Enter; focus loss never writes to another field.
End-only ordinary document remains untouched during capture and inserts at Stop, preserving external anchors.
All 188 prior tests plus four new tests passed; release lint reports zero errors.
Exact compiled source, all 134 bundle-member hashes, approved artwork and unchanged signed payload verified. Original update certificate matched.
preserved: Ordinary live-field editor/Chrome window and tail algorithms, typing/composition, capture/model/audio format, background readiness, cleanup budgets and cost controls unchanged.
scope: Accessibility broker/remote IPC, key and recognition events are explicit fixtures. Tests ran under Robolectric SDK 35. Native terminal input semantics are exercised, but installed Termux/Fold6, physical microphone, provider latency/billing and Play approval are not verified. The old implementation was inspected, not executed with the added tests.
delivery: Signed installable update saved successfully; local file identity applied and APK SHA256 unchanged after save.
